title: A Night To Remember
description: After a drinking contest with Sam Guevenne, the Dragonborn blacks out and wakes in the Temple of Dibella in Markarth with no memory of the night. Tracking down Sam and the promised staff leads through Rorikstead, Whiterun, and the fort of Morvunskar, where Sam reveals himself as the Daedric Prince Sanguine and bestows the Sanguine Rose.

base_facts: I travel from tavern to tavern challenging people to drinking contests.
I promised a valuable staff to anyone who can outdrink me.

DRINKING_CONTEST_ACCEPT: This traveler accepted my drinking contest. They might be fun.
MORVUNSKAR_SANGUINE: I have revealed my true identity as Sanguine, Daedric Prince of Debauchery, to my drinking buddy.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have rewarded my drinking buddy with the Sanguine Rose for their entertaining pursuit across Skyrim.
I teleported my drinking buddy back to the tavern where we first met — the night's revelry is complete.
The items I claimed were needed to repair the staff were a jest; I simply wanted to see what amusing trouble they would cause along the way.
I was merely introducing merriment and subversion into the mortal world, as is my nature as the Daedric Prince of Debauchery.

base_facts: I am a priestess of Dibella at the Temple of Dibella in Markarth.

TEMPLE_HANGOVER: This drunkard trashed our temple while raving about a goat and a wedding. They must clean up before I tell them anything.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The temple has been cleaned and the blasphemer has moved on — I have nothing more to say about that night.
I will address this traveler as I did before the incident; the matter is closed.

base_facts: I am a farmer in Rorikstead who owns a prized goat named Gleda.

RORIKSTEAD_GOAT: This fool stole my goat Gleda and sold her to a giant! I will not help them until Gleda is returned.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Gleda is safely home and that fool has moved on — I have nothing more to say about that night.
I will address this traveler as I did before the incident; the matter is closed.

base_facts: I am a trader in Whiterun with aspirations to deal with the Khajiit caravans.

YSOLDA_WEDDING_RING: This person bought a wedding ring from me on credit. Since the wedding is off, I want the ring or my money back.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The wedding ring matter is settled and that strange customer has moved on — I have nothing more to say about that night.
I will address this traveler as I did before the incident; the matter is closed.

base_facts: I am a hagraven who dwells in Witchmist Grove.

YSOLDA_WEDDING_RING: My darling promised to marry me! I will not let them leave without consummating our love!

beats.comment: Player meets Sam Guevenne in a tavern and accepts his drinking contest.

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to participate in the drinking contest.

beats.comment: Player wakes up in the Temple of Dibella after the blackout and must clean up the mess.
Player goes to Rorikstead and must retrieve Gleda the Goat from the giant Grok.
Player must get the wedding ring back from Moira the hagraven in Witchmist Grove and return it to Ysolda.
Player searches Morvunskar, enters the Misty Grove through a portal, and Sam reveals himself as Sanguine.
Sanguine rewards the player with the Sanguine Rose and teleports them back to the tavern where they met.
